merge_evidence.message:
Merge HDBSCAN sparse mutual-reachability MST: no m*m graph above 46,340 rows, exact tie order (identity PASS: NVIDIA A40, m2pro Metal+CPU, AMD MI325X; 70k card hashes identical on all three), scikit-learn min_samples matched on the board

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge Nystroem basis sort: a stable radix sort replaces the O(n^2) counting rank, so the 4096-row pool bound is gone (identity PASS: NVIDIA A40, m2pro, AMD MI325X; re-gated at 100,000 rows)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
